name: Operations and Supply Chain Management Association (O&SCMA)
description: The mission of OSCMA is to help students grow academically, professionally, and personally in the field of operations and supply chain management by connecting them with industry professionals, career development opportunities, and a supportive student community.

name: Order of Omega
description: Order of Omega’s goal is to recognize undergraduate fraternity and sorority leaders at our collegiate chapters in the United States , Canada, and The Bahamas. Undergraduate students, who belong to a recognized fraternity/sorority and who exemplify high standards in the areas of scholarship, leadership, and involvement within their respective organization and within the fraternity/sorority community, are selected for membership by the local collegiate chapter.

name: Origins
description: Our mission is to promote holistic student well-being through the study and practice of Bhakti Yoga. By offering mantra meditation, kirtan, yoga philosophy discussions, vegetarian cooking education, festivals, and retreats, we seek to help students develop physical, mental, emotional, intellectual, and spiritual strength within a welcoming and supportive community.

name: Orthodox Christian Campus Ministry at San José State University
